packageRules.description: Istio's four charts move together, one minor at a time (Talos upgrade plan, Track B)
prBodyNotes: Istio Helm upgrades allow one minor per step; base, cni, istiod and gateway are bumped together in this PR (vault: Talos v1.13 Upgrade Plan, Track B).

packageRules.description: Renovate never upgrades Flux: controllers are upgraded only by regenerating gotk-components.yaml with `flux install --export` (BOW-772)
OnCall's celery needs RabbitMQ's transient_nonexcl_queues permit; a new release can remove it (BOW-763)
prBodyNotes: Before merging, run `rabbitmqctl list_deprecated_features` on the new version: `transient_nonexcl_queues` must not be `removed`, or oncall-celery crash-loops (BOW-763).
